description: SteamServerAdmin is a standalone autonomous server administration platform managed inside Arbiter. It handles start, stop, restart, and update operations for Steam-based game servers via SteamCMD, enforces role-based permission systems, provides AI-driven health monitoring that reacts to live log thresholds, and exposes a full REST + web dashboard for remote administration. Any Arbiter-managed game project (e.g. Novaforge) can register its servers here to get full autonomous management.

arbiter_integration.notes: SteamServerAdmin is a fully standalone project. It lives in Projects/ so Arbiter can track its roadmap, but it has no runtime dependency on ArbiterEngine or the Arbiter IDE.

tech_stack.web_dashboard: React or Blazor (dark mode, ChatGPT palette)

phases.name: Phase 0 — Scaffold & Project Setup
phases.description: Initialise the SteamServerAdmin project structure, wire it into Arbiter as a managed project, and create the foundational config and logging infrastructure.

tasks.title: Initialise SteamServerAdmin project inside Arbiter Projects/ folder
tasks.notes: roadmap.json, directory skeleton (scripts/, config/, docs/, logs/, web/), .gitkeep markers created.

tasks.title: Per-server JSON config schema: app_id, install_path, branch, launch_args, restart_schedule, update_schedule
tasks.notes: Created config/server_schema.json (JSON Schema for per-server configs) and config/example_server.json (annotated example). Schema covers app_id, install_path, branch, launch_args, rcon, restart_schedule, update_schedule, health_rules, permissions, whitelist, notifications.

tasks.title: Logging setup: write to logs/steam_server_admin/ using a RotatingFileHandler; mirror the logger pattern from Arbiter’s core/logger.py
tasks.notes: Created src/logger.py — setup_ssa_logging() and get_ssa_logger() mirroring Arbiter core/logger.py. RotatingFileHandler (5 MB, 5 backups) writes to logs/steam_server_admin/<name>.log.

tasks.title: SteamCMD wrapper: verify SteamCMD is installed; detect platform (Windows/Linux); expose install/update/validate commands
tasks.notes: Created src/steamcmd.py — SteamCMD class with find_steamcmd() (platform detection, Windows/Linux paths, shutil.which fallback), update_app(), validate_app(), download_workshop_item(), run_script(). SteamCMDError raised on non-zero exit.

tasks.title: Register SteamServerAdmin as an Arbiter-tracked project — roadmap.json listed in Projects/ so it appears in Arbiter’s Projects panel (read-only tracking only; no runtime API coupling)
tasks.notes: SteamServerAdmin is already under Projects/SteamServerAdmin/ with roadmap.json. Added /projects/list and /projects/{id}/roadmap endpoints to ArbiterEngine server.py so the WPF Projects panel can enumerate all tracked projects automatically.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Core Server Management
phases.description: Core start/stop/restart/update operations for any registered Steam game server, with configurable pre-restart player warnings.

tasks.title: ServerManager: start server process — SteamCMD install + launch via config launch_args
tasks.notes: ServerManager.start() in src/server_manager.py: optional SteamCMD install if path missing, then Popen via config launch_args.

tasks.title: ServerManager: stop server — graceful RCON shutdown, then SIGTERM fallback with timeout
tasks.notes: ServerManager.stop(): tries RCON `quit` first (configurable timeout), then SIGTERM, then kill fallback. Stops supervisor thread first.

tasks.title: ServerManager: restart server — configurable countdown warning messages broadcast to players before shutdown
tasks.notes: ServerManager.restart(): broadcasts countdown warning via RCON say, then stop() → start(). warn_players flag controls whether RCON messages are sent.

tasks.title: ServerManager: update server — SteamCMD +app_update <id> validate; broadcast update warning; restart after
tasks.notes: ServerManager.update(): RCON warning, stop, SteamCMD +app_update validate, then restart. SteamCMDError surfaced as error dict.

tasks.title: Scheduled restarts/updates: cron-style schedule in per-server config; SteamServerAdmin dispatches automatically
tasks.notes: ServerScheduler: lightweight 5-field cron matcher (*, */N, exact). Fires restart or update in a daemon thread at the matched minute. Registered via MultiServerManager.load_configs().

tasks.title: Process supervisor: watch server PID; auto-restart on unexpected exit; write crash event to log
tasks.notes: ServerManager._supervisor_loop(): 5-second poll, detects unexpected exit, auto-restarts up to max_crash_restarts, emits crashed/max_crashes_reached events.

tasks.title: Multi-server support: manage any number of registered servers independently from one SteamServerAdmin instance
tasks.notes: MultiServerManager: load_configs() scans config/ (skips schema/example), registers each server independently, start_all()/stop_all() for bulk ops.

tasks.title: RCON integration: send console commands to live servers (kick, ban, say, status) via RCON protocol
tasks.notes: RCONClient: full Source RCON protocol (Source Engine), send_command(), used by stop(), restart(), update(), broadcast(), and send_rcon() public API.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Role-Based Permissions & Audit
phases.description: Enforced permission tiers for server operations, with audit logging of all changes visible in the SSA web dashboard.

tasks.title: Permission model: four tiers — Admin (full control), Moderator (kick/ban/say), Operator (restart/update), Standard Player (read-only status)
Per-server role config: map Steam IDs or usernames to roles in config/<server>.json
Dynamic restriction: role changes take effect without server restart; propagate to RCON and API layer immediately
Whitelist management: Admin-only; add/remove players; immediately reflected in server config
Audit log: every permission change, ban, kick, and restart is JSONL-logged with actor, timestamp, and reason
Audit log visible in SSA web dashboard admin panel and accessible via REST API (GET /servers/{id}/audit)
Permission change notifications: push alerts to SSA web dashboard and optionally to Discord webhook or email

phases.name: Phase 3 — REST API & Web Dashboard
phases.description: Full REST API and dark-mode web dashboard so SteamServerAdmin can be operated remotely from any browser.

tasks.title: FastAPI REST endpoints: GET /servers, POST /servers/{id}/start, /stop, /restart, /update, GET /servers/{id}/status, GET /servers/{id}/logs
WebSocket /ws/servers/{id}/logs: live log tail streamed to browser
REST permission endpoints: GET /servers/{id}/roles, POST /servers/{id}/roles, DELETE /servers/{id}/roles/{user}
REST audit endpoints: GET /servers/{id}/audit — paginated JSONL audit log
Token-based authentication: API key per user; role enforced per endpoint
Web dashboard (dark mode, ChatGPT palette): server list, per-server status cards, live log stream, restart/update buttons, role management table
Theming: web dashboard uses a built-in dark mode (ChatGPT palette); /api/theme endpoint returns current colour scheme for client use
LAN / remote access: expose API on LAN; optional ngrok or VPN tunnel for internet access

phases.name: Phase 4 — AI Health Monitoring & Arbiter Integration
phases.description: SSA monitors live server logs, detects health thresholds, and autonomously triggers admin actions. Uses a local AI (configurable LLM backend) for analysis and reporting — independent of any external AI platform.

tasks.title: Log ingestion pipeline: tail server logs in real-time; buffer recent lines for health rule evaluation and AI analysis queries
Health threshold rules (JSON config): define patterns (error rate, crash keyword, player count drop) that trigger actions
Autonomous action dispatch: SSA AI monitor matches log patterns to rules and calls ServerManager (restart/update/notify) without manual input; all actions written to audit log
AI analysis report: after each autonomous action, the local AI writes a summary to SSA’s own audit log and issues file with log context and action taken
AI chat panel in web dashboard: ask the AI “what happened to the server?” and get a natural-language summary from the audit log using the local LLM
Admin script generator: the local AI can generate new admin scripts or update existing ones in scripts/ based on observed failure patterns; changes are committed with [ssa-self-build] prefix
Resource monitoring: track server CPU/RAM/disk; alert and optionally restart if thresholds exceeded
Deployment: package SteamServerAdmin as a standalone service (Docker or Windows Service) deployable independently of the Arbiter WPF host

optional_enhancements: Multi-region server support with centralised dashboard
Player analytics: peak hours, average session, churn tracking
Discord / webhook notifications for restarts, updates, and permission events
Backup automation: snapshot server save files before each update
Mod management: install/update/remove mods via SteamCMD workshop IDs
Plugin architecture for non-Steam server backends (bare-metal, Pterodactyl)
AI-generated changelogs from SteamCMD update manifests
